What are QR Codes?

Quick Response (QR) codes are two-dimensional matrix barcodes capable of encoding diverse types of alphanumeric data, including website URLs, contact details (vCards), Wi-Fi credentials, and plain text. Readily scanned by standard smartphone cameras, they serve as instant links connecting physical print media directly to digital web resources.

Best Practices for QR Scanability

To guarantee your QR codes scan perfectly on every mobile device:

  • Ensure strong color contrast—always use dark foreground patterns on clean light backgrounds.
  • Keep an adequate 'quiet zone' (unprinted margin) around the QR code boundaries.
  • Test print samples at various physical distances on different mobile OS models before committing to mass production.
  • Use vector formats (SVG) when scaling for large banner and billboard printing.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do the QR codes generated on Tooleefy expire?

No. The generated codes are completely static, meaning they encode your target URL or text directly. They will work forever and never expire.

Can I edit the target link of a QR code after printing it?

Because Tooleefy generates secure, direct static QR codes to preserve your privacy, the content is baked into the image. You cannot change the URL after printing, as no tracking redirects are used.

What image formats can I export?

You can export your custom codes as high-density PNG files or scalable SVG vector formats, perfect for both digital layouts and professional print projects.
